note: Every record is an enacted appropriation — public law — and every one builds a page. Island and moku are set only where the enacted title names a place (each such reading is marked "confirm on first report" in geoContext); the rest are null until the program reports them. Act 96 alignment is null until the State states it. Program areas are this registry's working taxonomy, assigned from titles and corrected as programs report. Stories and outcomes stay behind the publication gate: a record publishes only with a story, at least one reported outcome, provenance, and its moku. Reports (public notices about a project) carry their source and render for every record. A human publishes, never an automated process.
